description: A PostHog Logs sampling rule: reduces ingested log or span volume by sampling by severity, dropping matching records, or rate-limiting them. Rules are evaluated in priority order and the first match wins.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the sampling rule belongs to.

Enabled.description: Whether the rule is active. Disabled rules are ignored by ingestion. Defaults to false.

Priority.description: Evaluation order: lower numbers are evaluated first and the first matching rule wins. Logs and span rules have separate orders. Omit to append after existing rules (PostHog assigns the next priority).

RuleType.description: Rule kind: `severity_sampling` (severity-based reduction), `path_drop` (drop matching records) or `rate_limit` (cap matching volume at ingestion). Span rules support `path_drop` and `rate_limit` only.

Source.description: Record source the rule filters: `logs` (default) runs in the logs pipeline, `spans` in the traces pipeline. Cannot be changed after creation.

ScopeService.description: Optional legacy service-name scope. New rules should match with `filter_group` in Config instead.

ScopePathPattern.description: Optional regex matched against a path-like log attribute when present.

ScopeAttributeFilters.description: Optional predicates over string attributes as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. [{"key": "http.route", "op": "eq", "value": "/api"}].

Config.description: Type-specific configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). path_drop: optional `filter_group` (AND/OR tree of property filters; every group needs at least one filter) and/or legacy `patterns` (regex list) with `match_attribute_key`. severity_sampling: `actions` per severity level and optional `always_keep`. rate_limit: either `logs_per_second` (1-1000000, optional `burst_logs`) or `kb_per_second` (1-1000000, optional `burst_kb`), not both, plus an optional `filter_group`.

Version.description: Incremented by PostHog on each update.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
